remarks.name: Guillermo Rauch
remarks.role: vercel CEO
remarks.text:
Welcoming Steren, creator of Google Cloud Run, to Vercel.

He will lead the Fluid family of compute products (Functions, Containers, Sandbox, Builds).

Serverless was the last chapter of the cloud, and Steren helped define the paradigm at Google.

Agents are the next frontier, and they require new compute primitives designed for them. Excited for Steren to lead this transition once again.
remarks.translation: 欢迎Steren——Google Cloud Run的创造者——加入Vercel。他将领导Fluid系列计算产品（Functions、Containers、Sandbox、Builds）。无服务器是云计算的上一篇章，而Steren曾在Google帮助定义了这一范式。智能体是下一个前沿，它们需要专为其设计的新计算原语。很高兴Steren能再次引领这一转变。

podcasts.excerpt: 几年前，加州理工学院教授、Accelerated Understanding联合创始人Anima Anandkumar着手开发首个基于AI的开源天气模型。在与该领域专家交流时，她遭遇了质疑。天气是混沌的，物理模拟很难，已经发展了几十年，而且需要超级计算机，数据根本不够。尽管有这些保留意见，Anima还是毅然前行并开始构建。不到一年，她的团队就开发出了FourCastNet，一个能与现有最佳物理模拟相媲美的预测模型。多亏了Anima及其后续工作，现在任何人都可以使用消费级GPU在短时间尺度上准确预测天气。在我们发布的约十五集科学类节目中，<a target="_blank" href="http://latent.…
podcasts.originalExcerpt: A few years ago, Caltech Prof. and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, Anima Anandkumar set out to develop the first open-source weather model with AI. Talking to experts in the field, she was met with skepticism. Weather is chaotic, physics simulations are hard, have been developed for decades, and require supercomputers, the data just isn’t there. Despite reservations, Anima went forth and built. Within a year her team had developed FourCastNet, a predictive model that is competitive with the best physics-based simulations available. Thanks to Anima, and her follow up work, anyone can now predict weather accurately over a short timescale using consumer grade GPUs.
